AnalysisFindingWire.description: One threshold-rule violation. The no-judge baseline signal.
AnalysisFindingWire.title: AnalysisFindingWire

ArtifactRef.description:
A heavy artifact (``.npy``, ``.png``, workspace dir) left on disk.

Heavy arrays never go inline: a browser must not parse a ``.npy``, and a
JSONL event must not carry an attention map.
ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

CorrectedRejections.description:
Family-level multiplicity control across every tested signal.

Testing 40 signals at alpha=0.05 yields ~2 "significant" results from luck
alone. Without this the screen is not a screen.

``mixed-BH/e-BH`` is its own member rather than being folded into either
neighbour: it says the family contained both p-values and e-values, which
carry different validity guarantees, and a reader weighing the verdict needs
to know that the guarantee is the weaker of the two.

deferred.description: True while the analysis phase withholds the verdict.
deferred.title: Deferred

rejected_result_keys.description: analysis_key values that survived. The source of truth.
rejected_result_keys.title: Rejected Result Keys

CorrectedRejections.title: CorrectedRejections

ExternalRef.description:
Pointer replacing an inline value that exceeded the size budget.

Detect by shape (``kind == "external_ref"``), lazy-load ``path``, and keep
``n_items`` visible while loading. Never render the pointer as one item.

path.description: Relative to runRoot. Never an absolute host path.
path.title: Path

n_items.description: Item count in the target, when countable.
n_items.title: N Items

bytes.description: Serialized size of the externalized value.
bytes.title: Bytes

ExternalRef.title: ExternalRef

JoinReport.description:
Health of one ``sample_id`` <-> ``FailureCase.id`` join.

This exists because a broken join and a real null result are indistinguishable
downstream: unmatched ids are skipped, both groups come out empty, and the
tool reports "no significant association" — the same output as a model with
no defect. Emitting coverage makes "the pipeline is broken" a separate,
visible state from "the model is fine".

unmatched_sample.description: First few unmatched ids, for triage.
unmatched_sample.title: Unmatched Sample

JoinReport.title: JoinReport

StageState.description:
Per-stage UI state. A single generic "N/A" loses information the reader
needs — in particular ``EMPTY`` (ran, produced nothing) and ``FAILED``
(did not run correctly) must never render the same.
StageState.title: StageState

StageStatus.description:
Terminal state of one stage in one cycle.

``EMPTY`` and ``ABSTAINED`` are successes with nothing to show; ``FAILED``
and ``UNAVAILABLE`` are not. Collapsing them loses the only signal a reader
has for whether to trust the absence of a result.

cycle.description: Normal cycles start at 0; the post-loop fix uses -1.
cycle.title: Cycle

reason.description: Why, for any state that is not plain success — the skip rule, the error, the reason for abstaining. One field, because a reader wants one answer.
reason.title: Reason

StageStatus.title: StageStatus

StatsToolResultWire.description:
One statistical test's verdict.

``reject`` is the RAW, uncorrected decision and must never drive a verdict on
its own. ``fdr_corrected`` is the family-level decision after multiplicity
control and is the only field a downstream verdict may read. They are kept as
separate fields precisely because collapsing them once let a p=0.14 result on
n=3 "support" a hypothesis.

measured.description:
WHAT this result is about, in words, and unique within the report — the label a chart axis or a table row should carry.

`tool` is the procedure, not the subject, and using it as a label put two rows reading 'Mcnemar evalue' on a chart with no way to tell them apart. `config['signal']` is the subject but is a machine name, and is absent on paired tools entirely. Neither can label a row on its own, so the producer states the label here.
measured.title: Measured

means.description: What the measured quantity IS, in one sentence, taken from the producing analyzer's `signal_docs`. Null means the analyzer did not document that metric — render it as undocumented rather than inventing a gloss, because a plausible wrong explanation of a statistic is worse than an admitted missing one.
means.title: Means

reject.description: RAW per-test decision. Not a verdict.
reject.title: Reject

fdr_corrected.description: Family-level decision after correction. None = correction not yet run (deferred descriptive phase) — which is NOT the same as False.
fdr_corrected.title: Fdr Corrected

analysis_key.description: Stable per-result key, e.g. 'signal_label_assoc:attention.entropy'. Required for correction: one tool NAME covers many tests.
analysis_key.title: Analysis Key

raw_reject.description: Pre-correction decision, kept for audit alongside `reject`.
raw_reject.title: Raw Reject

n_measured.description: Cases the producing analyzer actually measured. Analyzers measure every case unless capped (an analyzer's max_cases or the probe agent's max_cases_per_analyzer), so compare this with the batch size.
n_measured.title: N Measured

n_imputed_absent.description: Labeled cases with no measurement that were counted as signal-ABSENT. Valid for a genuinely sparse flag that only lists where it fired; invalid when the analyzer simply never looked. Nothing in the value distinguishes the two, so the count must travel with the result.
n_imputed_absent.title: N Imputed Absent

StatsToolResultWire.title: StatsToolResultWire

description:
M2's serialized report.

Two field groups with different authority: everything above
``descriptive_only`` is computed by code and is authoritative; ``conclusion``
and ``evidence_chain`` are written by the judge and are presentation only.
Empty narrative is valid and must never be backfilled with an invented
summary. The LLM may not write a number, and keeping the groups visibly
apart is what makes that reviewable.

Absent by design: the judge's prompt and raw response (already
``prompts/c<cycle>_m2_analysis.{prompt,response}.txt``), the tool-selection
plan (already ``artifacts/c<cycle>_m2_stats_plan.json``), the model name and
protocol (both in the run config and in :class:`AnalysisInput`), and the
threshold-rule narrative (a rendering of ``findings``).

descriptive_only.description: True = effect sizes and charts only, e-BH deferred. A reader MUST NOT render supported/rejected language while this is true.
descriptive_only.title: Descriptive Only

llm_fallback_reason.description: Non-empty only when the judge path was attempted AND raised. Not recoverable from the prompt files: a fallback still writes both of them.
llm_fallback_reason.title: Llm Fallback Reason

raw_results_ref.description: Path to the M1 ProbeOutput. The in-memory report carries the Result objects themselves, but to_dict() drops them — M4/M5 still need per-case signals, so the serialized contract carries a reference instead of pretending they survive.
raw_results_ref.title: Raw Results Ref

joins.description: Signal<->label join health. Zero coverage is a plumbing failure.
joins.title: Joins
